items.text: Horus Lupercal False Gods memory: Abaddon said 'They're traitors.'. Source record false_gods_ch06-c01-r001; key recall terms include horus_lupercal, false_gods_ch06, c01, who_said_theyre_traitors, abaddon.
The wrecked spaceship on Davin's moon: After Abaddon's declaration that nothing could have survived the crash, Horus asks who is broadcasting the signal, a question the source leaves unresolved.
Tember's flagship wreck: Abaddon says nothing could have survived the crash, and Horus asks who is broadcasting the signal.
